sessions.title: Marianne Jean-Baptiste & Mike Leigh’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The legendary director joins the star of his new film Hard Truths in the Criterion Closet, where they share their love for Akira Kurosawa and Charles Burnett, reminisce about early moviegoing experiences, and select favorites for each other.

sessions.title: Mike Leigh’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The legendary English director talks about discovering world cinema in his teenage years, the ways that Vivre sa vie gets to the “raw core of life,” the humor and politics in The Firemen’s Ball, and his experiences as a film student in London.
